Implemented the polyglot at [main.py.c](/app/polyglot/main.py.c).

Both commands are supported:

```bash
python3 /app/polyglot/main.py.c 100
gcc /app/polyglot/main.py.c -o /app/polyglot/cmain
/app/polyglot/cmain 100
```

The C implementation uses arbitrary-precision integers, so it agrees with Python beyond 64-bit range. Formal verification passed for indices `0`, `1`, `2`, `10`, `93`, `100`, and `500`, with both execution paths producing identical results.
